events.title: BYOB (Bring Your Own Beamer) Pop-Up Projector Show
events.why: Gray Area's one-night Bring Your Own Beamer show: artists haul in projectors for ephemeral generative visuals, moving light, and strange hardware contraptions. Direct from the Deliria2 venue.

events.title: On Speculative Futures
events.why: Author Radhika Singh and Omar Zahzah discuss how science fiction can answer political questions of our time, from surveillance states to colonialism, through her novel Earthly Playing Field.

events.title: Partial Lunar Eclipse Watch Party
events.why: Chabot astronomers host a live lunar eclipse watch with real-time commentary and observation deck viewing as the Moon drifts through Earth's shadow. Peak shadow depth at 9:13pm.

events.title: Black August Film Screening: The Strike
events.why: The Strike documentary on Pelican Bay's hunger strike paired with a panel, community dinner, healing sessions, and prisoner letter writing. A full community program, not just a screening.

events.title: Merope w/ Shahzad Ismaily + David Wesley Golightly
events.why: Lithuanian folk forms, experimental guitar, and an Oakland composer returning to acoustic piano for his debut solo album release. Properly sidelong Friday-night listening.

events.price_note: Ticketed; two performances at 2:30 and 6pm doors
events.title: Ambrose Trataris: Daisy-Chain Star-Connection
events.why: World premiere hybrid VR performance at Gray Area blending contemporary dance, drag artistry, 3D world design, and motion capture for a queer worldbuilding piece about seeing and being seen.

events.title: Berkeley Frog Fest
events.why: A free art-and-science frog festival with live amphibians, Museum of Vertebrate Zoology tours, an amphibioscope horoscope, frog origami, cyanotypes, and a board game about saving frogs from a pandemic.

events.title: Scumdance Film Festival (10th Annual)
events.why: Ten years of celebrating the weirdest micro-budget films from around the world. Horror, comedy, animation, and indescribable shorts by punks and oddballs, capped by the Scummies award show.

events.title: Xicana Moratorium Block Party
events.why: EastSide's annual block party honoring the Chicano Moratorium legacy with DJ La Femme Papi, facepainting, screenprinting, food, and a children's art station at their headquarters.

events.title: It Is Not in Heaven: A Talmudic Argument About an Oven and the Case Against Letting AI Decide
events.why: A lunch talk reading a Talmudic refusal of a heavenly oracle as an early case against letting AI settle legal questions. Can a correct answer from the wrong kind of source still be wrong?

events.title: CROSSROADS 2026 Presented by San Francisco Cinematheque & Gray Area
events.why: The 17th CROSSROADS festival: 49 works by 52 artists from 22 countries across 8 programs of avant-garde film and performance. JG Thirlwell live-scores Harry Smith's Heaven and Earth Magic.

events.title: Agentworld x Superdark Factory: Antikythera x Disintegrator
events.why: Benjamin Bratton and Marek Poliks deliver a double-lecture on how trillions of AI agents and fully automated agentic systems will reconfigure society. Bratton authored The Stack.
